# University of New Hampshire

> University of New Hampshire's official portal for admissions, giving, and family engagement programs.

UNH serves as a comprehensive resource for prospective students, international applicants, donors, and families seeking information about undergraduate programs, financial support, and campus involvement. The university emphasizes accessibility through multiple pathways including the Verto Wildcats Abroad Program and New England Regional Student Program (NERSP).

## Key Topics

- International Students
- Undergraduate Admissions
- Donor Giving
- Financial Aid
- Campus Visit
- Parent Resources
- Student Recruitment
- Gift Planning
- Charitable Giving
- Endowment
- New Student & Family Programs
- Wildcat Days
- Family Weekend
- Application Process
- Tribute Gifts

## Admissions & Student Recruitment

- [International Students | Undergraduate Admissions](https://admissions.unh.edu/international-students): International student admissions info and resources for UNH undergraduate programs

## Giving & Philanthropy

- [Giving to UNH | University of New Hampshire](https://www.unh.edu/give): Donation and fundraising portal for UNH Foundation and university initiatives

## Family & Parent Programs

- [Parents & Families | New Student & Family Programs](https://www.unh.edu/new-students/parents-families): Parent and family resources, orientation, and engagement programs at UNH
